messages.author: Hugo Condesa
messages.message:
BREAKING: AMD, $AMD, officially denies claims made by Hunterbrook Media that sent the stock -13% lower, saying that the claims "misrepresent AMD's business practices and relationships," per Bloomberg.

"AMD complies with applicable US export control laws and regulations and maintains rigorous processes to ensure compliance across our global operations," a spokesperson said. 

"We remain focused on serving our customers and upholding the highest standards of integrity," they added.

Hunterbrook Capital released the report with a short position in the stock.
(@TheKobeissiLetter)
